basic_info.description: Introducing a charming Mediterranean-style, moving-in ready conditioned single-family home nestled in the desirable Portola neighborhood. Built in 1931, fully detached, beautifully maintained residence showcases the architectural elegance. Enjoy exterior features like stucco walls, clay tile roofing and arched windows. The living room is bathed in natural light that streams through the large arched windows, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. The gleaming hardwood floors throughout add a touch of elegance and the original hardwood fireplace provides warmth and a cozy gathering space. A remodeled kitchen features modern appliances, granite counters and custom wood cabinetry. The rear of the house features two spacious bedrooms and one bathroom with a separate tub & shower stall and a bidet seat. It is complemented by an additional bedroom or bonus room on the lower level. Large storage room, a laundry room with a built-in deep sink, and an over-sized one car parking space completes this floor. The new is professionally done with turf grass and a large patio area to gather with friends and families. From parks and recreational facilities to schools and transportation options, everything you need is within reach. Don't miss the opportunity! Schedule a showing!
